entries.subject: A published two-dimensional map of KELT-9b
entries.finding: No paper deposits or prints a map of KELT-9b. The Spitzer (Mansfield et al. 2020) and TESS (Wong et al. 2020) papers publish phase-curve fits, and KPF phase-resolved spectra (2026, arXiv:2601.20849) measure winds on the emerging day side, not a map.
entries.revisitWhen: A map of KELT-9b is published or deposited.

entries.subject: Mansfield et al. (2020) Spitzer 4.5 um two-sinusoid phase-curve fit, as a map of longitude
entries.finding: Shown as the temperature lens through the Cowan & Agol (2008) inversion. The fit reproduces the paper's amplitude (0.612 against 0.609 +/- 0.020), night side (2,542 K against 2,556 +101/-97 K) and hottest hemisphere (4,623 K against 4,636 K) once the star's 4.5 um temperature is set by the paper's own day side (7,942 K). The curve peaks 16.5 degrees before eclipse against the paper's 18.7 +2.1/-2.3.

entries.subject: Wong et al. (2020) TESS phase curve: day side 4,600 +/- 100 K, night side 3,040 +/- 100 K, hot spot 5.2 +/- 0.9 degrees east
entries.finding: A second band of the same kind of fit. Not shown so that both hot Jupiters of this route share one band (Spitzer 4.5 um); its sinusoid fit and the star's pulsations would need their own record.
entries.revisitWhen: A second lens per planet is wanted, or TESS becomes the only band for either planet.

entries.subject: JWST program 7255 (PI K. Stevenson), a full-orbit NIRISS/SOSS phase curve of KELT-9b
entries.finding: Cycle 4 program; on 2026-09-23 MAST lists its observation without public data and no paper exists.
entries.revisitWhen: The program's data become public or its paper publishes a map.

entries.subject: The 8,287 K stellar brightness temperature at 4.5 um in Mansfield et al. (2020), section 5
entries.finding: Used by the paper for its energy-balance model (PHOENIX, 10,200 K). Through it the eclipse depth gives a 4,739 K day side, not the paper's 4,566 K, so it is not the conversion behind the reported temperatures; the lens uses the one those temperatures imply.
entries.revisitWhen: The paper's PHOENIX band conversion is published.
